title: Cosmic zoo explanation for diverse craft

tellings.quote: Um the idea that we're living in a cosmic zoo.

plain: On a podcast episode with podcast host Jesse Michels about Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange happenings, a speaker raises the idea that we are living in a cosmic zoo. The idea is offered to explain why so many different kinds of craft are reported there: it would mean Earth is being watched by many visitors.
